title: Opposite Words (v1)  [Kids Vocab] Big & Small, Open & Close ↔️ Easy Opposite Words
speaker: English Singsing
zh: 【English Singsing】反義詞 (v1) [兒童詞彙] 大和小，開啟和關閉 ↔️ 簡單的反義詞（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Opposite Words big – small
cues.en: Opposite Words big – small
cues.zh: 反義詞大-小

cues.text: big big elephant small small mouse
cues.en: big big elephant small small mouse
cues.zh: 大大大像小老鼠

cues.text: big and small tall – short tall
cues.en: big and small tall – short tall
cues.zh: 大和小高 – 矮高

cues.text: tall gentleman short short boy tall and short
cues.en: tall gentleman short short boy tall and short
cues.zh: 高個子 紳士 矮個子 男孩 高個子 矮個子

cues.text: weak – strong weak weak man
cues.en: weak – strong weak weak man
cues.zh: 弱 – 強弱弱的人

cues.text: strong strong man weak and strong soft – hard
cues.en: strong strong man weak and strong soft – hard
cues.zh: 強者強者弱者強者軟硬

cues.text: soft soft cotton candy hard hard rock
cues.en: soft soft cotton candy hard hard rock
cues.zh: 軟軟棉花糖硬搖滾

cues.text: soft and hard fast – slow
cues.en: soft and hard fast – slow
cues.zh: 軟硬快-慢

cues.text: fast fast car slow slow bicycle
cues.en: fast fast car slow slow bicycle
cues.zh: 快快的汽車慢慢的腳踏車

cues.text: fast and slow heavy – light
cues.en: fast and slow heavy – light
cues.zh: 快和慢重-輕

cues.text: heavy heavy dinosaur light light feather
cues.en: heavy heavy dinosaur light light feather
cues.zh: 重 重 恐龍 輕 輕 羽毛

cues.text: heavy and light full – empty
cues.en: heavy and light full – empty
cues.zh: 重與輕滿-空

cues.text: full full cup empty empty cup
cues.en: full full cup empty empty cup
cues.zh: 滿滿杯空杯

cues.text: full and empty dirty – clean dirty
cues.en: full and empty dirty – clean dirty
cues.zh: 滿的和空的髒－乾淨的髒

cues.text: dirty room clean clean room dirty and clean
cues.en: dirty room clean clean room dirty and clean
cues.zh: 骯髒的房間 乾淨的 乾淨的 房間又髒又乾淨

cues.text: go – stop go go sign
cues.en: go – stop go go sign
cues.zh: 走-停止走走標誌

cues.text: stop stop sign go and stop open – close
cues.en: stop stop sign go and stop open – close
cues.zh: 停止 停止標誌 離開並停止 開啟 – 關閉

cues.text: open open the door close close the door
cues.en: open open the door close close the door
cues.zh: 開啟 開啟門 關閉 關上門

cues.text: open and close push – pull
cues.en: open and close push – pull
cues.zh: 開啟和關閉推拉

cues.text: push push a cart pull pull a cart
cues.en: push push a cart pull pull a cart
cues.zh: 推 推車 拉 拉車

cues.text: push and pull wet – dry
cues.en: push and pull wet – dry
cues.zh: 推拉濕-乾

cues.text: wet wet towel dry dry towel
cues.en: wet wet towel dry dry towel
cues.zh: 濕毛巾 乾毛巾 乾毛巾

cues.text: wet and dry new – old
cues.en: wet and dry new – old
cues.zh: 乾濕新舊

cues.text: new new car old old car
cues.en: new new car old old car
cues.zh: 新車 新車 舊車 舊車

cues.text: new and old up – down up
cues.en: new and old up – down up
cues.zh: 新舊向上 – 向下向上

cues.text: go up stairs down go down stairs
cues.en: go up stairs down go down stairs
cues.zh: 上樓梯 下 下樓梯

cues.text: up and down on – off on
cues.en: up and down on – off on
cues.zh: 上下 開 – 關 開

cues.text: turn on the light off turn off the light
cues.en: turn on the light off turn off the light
cues.zh: 開燈 關燈 關燈

cues.text: on and off
cues.en: on and off
cues.zh: 開和關
